tasks.short: Demonstrate systems and explain false alarms

steps.what: Demonstrate systems for customers and explain false alarms using the installed configuration

tasks.design: Keep the installed-system demonstration and explanation human, using current instructions in {DOCS}. Test native instruction access if a separate retrieval burden appears; a generic answer draft does not replace checking customer understanding.
tasks.previous_blocker: Explanation depends on the actual configuration and customer behaviour.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital instructions support reference without establishing less demonstration time.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising misunderstanding that could cause unwanted alarms.
tasks.human_edge: Showing the actual system and adapting explanations to the customer's questions.

evidence.claim: Live demonstration and customer understanding remain human; the supplied work-order tools do not establish their replacement.

tasks.short: Inspect sites and determine installation requirements

steps.what: Inspect installation sites and collect current work orders, plans and equipment references
Study installation manuals and plans to compare documented material and procedure requirements

loop.purpose: Compare supplied manuals and plans against the site question
loop.input: Checked document set, equipment versions and installer observations
loop.output: Cited requirement passages, candidate material considerations and unresolved conflicts
loop.check: Installer opens every citation and checks equipment applicability, drawing revision, site meaning and omissions; no generated instruction is accepted on wording alone
loop.stop: One comparison and correction; conflicting or missing information returns to manual study and clarification
loop.why_not_simpler: Narrative manuals and site notes need contextual comparison beyond keyword lookup

steps.what: Determine materials requirements and installation procedures from verified sources and site judgement

tasks.design: Test native search in {DOCS} before adding a bounded requirements comparison over current plans, manuals and installer observations. The installer checks every source and determines the proposal; physical inspection and final technical judgement retain their time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant requirements are spread across different manuals, plans and site observations.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded source comparison can point to relevant passages for installer review.
tasks.still_hard: Actual site constraints and conflicts between documents need competent interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Connecting documentation to the real installation and recognising an incomplete or incompatible proposal.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated comparison writing; installation judgement remains with the installer.

reach.task: Review unresolved document and site conflicts
reach.learn: Version control and technical query formulation

evidence.claim: A source-bounded manual comparison is plausible; the supplied work-order and maintenance-record capabilities do not demonstrate its labour savings.

assumptions: Boundary covers installer inspection, study and proposal, excluding engineering approval, purchasing, physical installation and acceptance tests.

Installer in s1 gathers current plans/manuals and captures site/job ID, equipment model/revision, document IDs/pages, observed routes and constraints, measurements and open questions. Inspection, capture and manual source retrieval retain all 40 hours; missing fields or documents return to manual collection.
The loop reads supplied originals; it receives no free structured quantity takeoff, compliance flag or validated as-built model. Installer handles drawings that cannot be read reliably manually.
Native search is tested first. No automatic purchasing, device programming or change to alarm settings is proposed.
research_questions: Does a comparison trial reduce time after source opening, applicability checks and corrections?

already_counted.description: Site capture, source meaning verification and requirements judgement

incremental.description: Maintain document packet and comparison checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=40+35*0.70+25=89.5, gross=10.5, focal upkeep=6, net=4.5. Range 0-2 assumes accessible repeated manual comparisons; stale plans or extensive site uncertainty eliminate the gain.
